import requests
import pytest

ENDPOINT = 'https://api.example.com/items/1'
HTTP_METHOD = 'GET'

def _make_request(method, url, json=None, headers=None):
    """Send an HTTP request using the requests library."""
    if headers is None:
        headers = {}
    method = method.upper()
    if method == "GET":
        return requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    elif method == "POST":
        return requests.post(url, json=json, headers=headers)
    elif method == "PUT":
        return requests.put(url, json=json, headers=headers)
    elif method == "PATCH":
        return requests.patch(url, json=json, headers=headers)
    elif method == "DELETE":
        return requests.delete(url, headers=headers)
    elif method == "HEAD":
        return requests.head(url, headers=headers)
    elif method == "OPTIONS":
        return requests.options(url, headers=headers)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported HTTP method: {method}")

def test_positive_get_item_200():
    """TC-POS-01 - Get item 200 - Valid request"""
    response = _make_request('GET', ENDPOINT)
    assert response.status_code == 200

# --- Negative Test Cases ---

def test_negative_not_found_404():
    """TC-NEG-01 - Not found 404"""
    response = _make_request('GET', 'https://api.example.com/items/999')
    assert response.status_code == 404
